name: Znect CI Bridge
description: Free-first CircleCI diagnostics channel using signed webhooks, Cloudflare Workers, KV, a browser dashboard, and manual ChatGPT Free export.
permissions: Store bounded CI event history in Cloudflare KV
Expose authenticated read-only diagnostic data to the dashboard
limitations: Full job log and artifact retrieval not yet implemented
ChatGPT Free handoff is manual Markdown export
